engineering.title: House Map / Drawing
engineering.text: Complete working drawings — plans, elevations, sections and detail drawings ready for the municipality and the site.

engineering.title: Architectural Design
engineering.text: Layouts planned around light, ventilation and your family's daily routine, with 3D views before anything is finalised.

engineering.title: Structural Design
engineering.text: Earthquake-resistant RCC design with full analysis, reinforcement detailing and a signed structural report.

engineering.title: Estimate & BOQ
engineering.text: Item-wise bill of quantities and rate analysis, so you know the real cost before committing to a contractor.

engineering.title: Building Permit Consultancy
engineering.text: Document preparation, submission and follow-up until the municipal building permit is issued.

engineering.title: Site Supervision
engineering.text: Scheduled site visits checking steel, concrete, levels and workmanship, with a written report each time.

engineering.title: Engineering Consultancy
engineering.text: Second-opinion reviews, feasibility studies, soil test coordination, retrofitting advice and valuation reports for banks and buyers.

engineering.title: Land Valuation
engineering.text: Independent land and building valuation based on recent transactions, road access, zoning and development potential.

construction.title: Residential Construction
construction.text: Family homes, duplexes and bungalows built to approved drawings with quality-checked materials.

construction.title: Commercial Construction
construction.text: Office blocks, showrooms and mixed-use buildings designed around rentable floor area.

construction.title: Turnkey Construction
construction.text: One contract covering design, permit, structure, finishing and handover — you receive the keys.

construction.title: Construction Contract
construction.text: Labour-only or material-and-labour contracts with itemised BOQ and staged billing.
